schema.description:
Describes the external assurance assigned to the data provided by an organization for reporting
purposes over a given period of time.

It provides a general characterization of an organizations data by an independent assurance provider.

Available values are: Limited, Reasonable, and None.
schema.title: Reporting Assurance

valid_to_datetime.description: A date and optional time at which the assurance value ends, in ISO 8601 date time standardized format.

emission_report_id.description: The optional Foreign Key of the Report for which the Reporting Assurance statement is issued. The relationship confirms that the Report adheres to the Standards (i.e., Emission Report Per Standard records) listed on the Valid From Datetime that the Reporting Assurance statement was issued.

reviewers.description:
The individuals, or roles, which reviewed and determined the Reporting Assurance value.

The reviewer details are left to the user to implement, but can be implemented using the master data Contact Person entity.

issuer_id.description: The Foreign Key of the Issuer (Organization) of an assurance value to the Organization submitting a report.

valid_from_datetime.description: A date and optional time that assurance value starts from in ISO 8601 date time standardized format.

organization_id.description: The Foreign Key of the Organization to which the assurance value has been assigned.

effective_date.description: The date and optional time when the Reporting Assurance determination for the Organization has taken place.

facility_id.description: The optional Foreign Key of the Facility for which this Reporting Assurance statement is issued. The relationship confirms that the data produced by this Facility for the stated Valid From and Valid To period has been assured by an independent organization.

reporting_assurance_type_id.description: The Foreign Key of the assurance type assigned to the Organization: Limited, Reasonable, and None.

comment.description: Any additional context to support the determination of the Reporting Assurance.

reporting_assurance_id.description: The Primary Key assigned to the Reporting Assurance.

emission_statement_id.description: The optional Foreign Key of the Emission Statement for which Reporting Assurance was issued.

equipment_id.description: The optional Foreign Key of the Equipment for which the Reporting Assurance statement is issued. The relationship confirms that the data produced by the Equipment for the stated Valid From and Valid To period has been assured by an independent organization.

id.description: Unique identifier of an OSDU record.

version.description: Version number of this OSDU record.
